target: forge.sh kind — zero requests across every detection path, with a positive control that reaches the shim in the same run
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests/7" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" 200 '{"username":"x"}'
fx_run kind
export FORGE=gitlab; fx_run kind; unset FORGE
printf 'FORGE=github\n' > .env; fx_run kind; rm .env
fx_config '{"forge":{"kind":"none"}}'; fx_run kind; rm -rf .agentic
fx_setremote https://github.example.test/o/r.git; fx_run kind
fx_setremote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
echo "kind_requests=$(fx_nreq)"; echo "kind_calls=$(fx_ncalls)"
fx_run pr-state https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7
echo "control=$FX_OUT"; echo "after_requests=$(fx_nreq)"; fx_reqs
fx_done
